request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them). --behaviour

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: This test expected list(todos) with no options to include completed todos ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). The instruction makes hiding completed todos the default, so I moved that expectation to list(todos, { includeDone: true }) and added a check that the default call returns "[ ] eggs".
